title: Trust in foundation models and GenAI: A geographic perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual evaluation and literature review of spatial data heterogeneity, regional data scarcity (e.g., rural vs. urban data availability), and spatial representation imbalances in global datasets.
Conceptual analysis of foundation models' reliance on English-language dominance and Western-centric cultural perspectives in training data.
Conceptual review of data collection disparities (e.g., sampling density in affluent versus marginalized communities) and historical societal inequities like redlining.
